content.title: Neighborhood Errand Compression | Treat, Shop Handoff and Bagged Exit
content.summary: An adult cyclist walks into a repair kiosk and exits with a service envelope and repaired bicycle. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult subject keeps the same clothing, bag and route direction. + The opening handheld object remains traceable until the destination is entered. + A visible counter handoff provides the causal completion event. + The received object differs clearly from the opening object and remains readable at the end. + The route, destination and payoff form one ordinary task without unrelated flashbacks.
quick_start.recommended_input: Establish one original adult cyclist resting in a quiet courtyard while drinking from a cobalt bottle. Use one rear-follow move to carry the same adult through the kiosk door on a single left-to-right route. End with the cyclist facing camera outside the kiosk, envelope in one hand and repaired bicycle beside them.
required_anchors: One clearly adult subject keeps the same clothing, bag and route direction.
The opening handheld object remains traceable until the destination is entered.
The received object differs clearly from the opening object and remains readable at the end.
The route, destination and payoff form one ordinary task without unrelated flashbacks.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An adult cyclist walks into a repair kiosk and exits with a service envelope and repaired bicycle. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.

Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 用同一人物、手持物和街区路线压缩一个简单日常任务：先建立边吃边停留的状态，再连续步行进入小店，与柜台人物完成物品交接，最后让新纸袋成为任务完成证据。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult subject keeps the same clothing, bag and route direction.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult subject keeps the same clothing, bag and route direction."

invariants.rule: The opening handheld object remains traceable until the destination is entered.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "The opening handheld object remains traceable until the destination is entered."

invariants.rule: A visible counter handoff provides the causal completion event.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "A visible counter handoff provides the causal completion event."

invariants.rule: The received object differs clearly from the opening object and remains readable at the end.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "The received object differs clearly from the opening object and remains readable at the end."

invariants.rule: The route, destination and payoff form one ordinary task without unrelated flashbacks.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The route, destination and payoff form one ordinary task without unrelated flashbacks."

slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.
